desc: As an administrative staff member, I want to register patients with personal data and medical background, so that the hospital can maintain accurate and complete patient records.
ac: The system allows entry of personal and medical background data
Each patient receives a unique identifier
Duplicate identity documents or identifiers are not allowed

desc: As an administrative staff member, I want to modify the personal and contact details of a registered patient, so that patient information remains up to date.
ac: The system allows editing of existing patient records

desc: As an administrative staff member, I want to search for patients by name, identity document, or identifier number, so that I can quickly locate patient records.
ac: The system supports search by name, document, or identifier

desc: As an authorized user, I want to visualize a patient's complete information, so that I can review all relevant details for care or administration.
ac: The system displays all patient data in a single view

desc: As an administrative staff member, I want to create medical appointments by associating the patient, specialty, and professional, so that appointments are scheduled accurately.
ac: The system allows selection of patient, specialty, and doctor
Overlapping appointments are prevented

desc: As an administrative staff member, I want to visualize the availability of registered doctors, so that I can schedule appointments efficiently.
ac: The system displays doctors’ schedules and availability

desc: As an administrative staff member, I want to modify or cancel existing appointments, so that changes can be managed as needed.
ac: The system allows editing and canceling of appointments
Patients are notified of changes

desc: As a patient, I want to receive notifications when my appointment is modified or canceled, so that I am always informed about my schedule.
ac: Notifications are sent promptly after changes

desc: As an administrative staff member, I want to manage the status of appointments throughout their lifecycle, so that the hospital can track appointment outcomes.
ac: Appointment statuses include Confirmed, Canceled, Attended, Not attended

desc: As a doctor, I want to register diagnoses, treatments, and patient’s clinical progress in the electronic clinical record, so that patient care is well documented.
ac: The system allows entry and editing of clinical records
Each entry is timestamped

desc: As a patient, I want to consult my electronic clinical record, so that I can stay informed about my health history.
ac: Patients can view but not edit their records
Access is restricted to authorized users

desc: As an administrator, I want to register medical professionals with their personal and contact details and associate specialties, so that the hospital can manage staff information.
ac: The system allows entry and editing of staff data and specialties

desc: As an administrator, I want to define and modify attention hours and activate/deactivate professionals for scheduling, so that doctor availability is accurately reflected.
ac: The system supports setting and updating working hours
Professionals can be activated or deactivated for scheduling

desc: As an administrator, I want to manage roles and access permissions to system functionalities, so that users only access features relevant to their role.
ac: The system enforces role-based access control
Permissions are validated before actions are executed

desc: As an administrative staff member, I want to generate electronic invoices for medical consultations and medication delivery, so that billing is accurate and efficient.
ac: The system generates invoices with unique identifiers
Invoices are associated with patients and services

desc: As a patient, I want to receive automatic notifications with attached digital invoices when an invoice is generated, so that I am promptly informed about charges.
ac: Notifications are sent with invoice attachments

desc: As a pharmacist, I want to register medications and supplies with identification, stock, and expiration date, so that inventory is accurately tracked.
ac: The system allows entry of medication/supply data

desc: As a pharmacist, I want to automatically update stock when registering medication deliveries, so that inventory levels remain current.
ac: Stock is updated in real time upon delivery

desc: As a pharmacist, I want to be notified when stock is low or items are about to expire, so that I can take timely action.
ac: The system detects minimum stock and upcoming expirations and sends notifications

desc: As a pharmacist, I want to consult inventory sorted by available quantity or expiration date, so that I can manage stock efficiently.
ac: Inventory can be sorted by quantity or expiration

desc: As an analyst, I want to generate reports on consultations by specialty, appointment status, financial income, and medication/supplies consumption, with date range filters, so that I can analyze hospital performance.
ac: Reports include all specified metrics
Reports can be filtered by date range

desc: As a system administrator, I want to ensure date validations prevent invalid ranges, so that data integrity is maintained.
ac: The system does not allow invalid date ranges

desc: As a system administrator, I want to ensure notifications are sent within a reasonable time after triggering events, so that users are promptly informed.
ac: Notifications are sent shortly after relevant events
